explication: ReactOS is an NT-compatible operating system intended to run existing Windows applications and drivers. The broad user-to-result path is launching an application through the Windows-compatible user-mode interfaces, which rely on kernel services and hardware drivers. The sampled files show only slices of this architecture, alongside several substantial compatibility subsystems; the README documents the wider product goal. Dashed links mark architectural relationships that are documented or plausible but not directly traced in the excerpts.
